summary: Insufficiently stamped agreement of sale as evidence in injunction suit; Sections 33/34 vs 37/39 jurisdictional conflict; deficit stamp duty + tenfold penalty mandatory; trial court lacked discretion to waive penalty; High Court review dismissed; exclusive District Registrar authority for penalty under Section 39; no evidence validity without full compliance; stamp impoundment proper.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's order upheld; deficit stamp duty and penalty payment mandated within six months.
